awaitingApproval.title: Shared loading, error, empty and stale states; disabled controls
awaitingApproval.note: Actual components with exact production CSS. Loading becomes vertical/centered; distinct hard-error, empty-success and stale-retained states gain icons/Retry. Disabled Button/Tabs/menu opacity rises to 70%. Shared destructive-modal styling is shown using an SSH example.

awaitingApproval.title: Grouped eligible-model role picker and role-load recovery
awaitingApproval.note: Native selects become searchable grouped eligible-model pickers. Chat/Specialized headings, saved absent-model option and No eligible models state are shown. Role-load failure gets truthful recovery.

awaitingApproval.title: Provider list, credentials, stale refresh and logout safety
awaitingApproval.note: Shows disconnected action locks, auth/discovery-specific states, explicit Remove API key/Keep API key undo, and pre-logout confirmation. These are boundary fixtures, not real credentials. A post-save configuration failure was not captured and is not claimed as proof.

awaitingApproval.title: Cached, missing and restarting settings-schema notices
awaitingApproval.note: Agent-backed settings disclose unavailable/restarting status, keep cached values for navigation only, lock editing, and expose Retry. These compare rendered recovery components, not an entire settings-navigation interaction.

awaitingApproval.title: Agent Hub pause/resume, disconnected actions and roster errors
awaitingApproval.note: Pause all agents/Resume all agents controls are new; disconnected actions lock; roster failure is no longer presented as no agents.

awaitingApproval.title: Useful context report when capacity is unknown
awaitingApproval.note: Actual ContextReportDialog: measured used tokens remain useful; Context window unknown replaces misleading percentages/zero capacity. Free/remaining-capacity rows are omitted.

awaitingApproval.title: Security prerequisites and enable-before-scan confirmation
awaitingApproval.note: Scan blockers explain missing repository/model; disabled security no longer silently flips on. The enable-scan confirmation is shown separately from the shared dialog styling.

awaitingApproval.title: SSH unknown health and explicit host deletion warning
awaitingApproval.note: Never-probed hosts are gray/unknown rather than falsely Connected. Host deletion names the target and requires a cancel-first confirmation.

awaitingApproval.title: Repository stale retention and inventory/transcript recovery
awaitingApproval.note: Failed same-session repository refresh retains the last diff; inventory/transcript failures expose recovery rather than empty content or endless loading.

awaitingApproval.title: Stats startup/retry, Never, source sections, rankings and list rows
awaitingApproval.note: Actual stats routes with controlled payloads: startup syncing recovery, hard-error disclosure, Never for never-used tools, single positive source section, aggregate-ranked top-four provider timeline, and rendered error/project list responses.

awaitingApproval.title: Sidecar restart/exhaustion and dismissible updater failure
awaitingApproval.note: Restart attempts remain amber and visible; exhaustion is red with attempt count. Update notices add a dismiss control and remain hidden after dismissal.

awaitingApproval.title: Disconnected MCP and PR creation controls
awaitingApproval.note: Creation forms expose disconnected reasons and lock their mutation actions. Shared disabled styling is already covered in F1.

awaitingApproval.title: Command Center fetch failures, chat and disconnected reasons
awaitingApproval.note: A failed command fetch gains explicit alert/Retry. Chat-only restrictions and Sidecar not connected reasons are shown on unavailable rows instead of silent no-ops.

awaitingApproval.title: Per-row status markers removed; conversation navigation retained
awaitingApproval.note: Actual whole-app captures with the same 200-message fixture. Upstream removes row status/check/time markers, not the conversation navigator’s tick rail. Previously approved transcript density is visible here in the full app.

awaitingApproval.title: Transcript scroll and send-to-tail controls
awaitingApproval.note: Actual running-app recordings: wheel into history, submit a new prompt, wheel upward, then Jump to latest. These illustrate the real controls; they are not a proof of all hydration/pagination or long-stream anchoring boundaries.

awaitingApproval.title: Drawer entrance fades become right-to-left slides
awaitingApproval.note: Clearly labeled representative illustration using exact production CSS, not actual drawer content. Applies the same transition class used by Agent Hub transcript/detail, Plugin Detail and Files detail; workspace remains stationary.

awaitingApproval.title: Duplicate-key errors and removable global overrides
awaitingApproval.note: Actual RecordKvEditor and SchemaSettingRow: a duplicate rename preserves both rows and shows inline error rather than losing the colliding row; an existing value without a schema default gains Remove global override.

awaitingApproval.title: Blocked model rows with explicit disabled/authentication reasons
awaitingApproval.note: Actual ModelCompare rows: unavailable providers dim and disable Use. The bottom box is explicitly labeled illustrative framing; it mirrors real row title attributes because headless screenshots cannot capture native tooltip bubbles.

awaitingApproval.title: Skills detail failure gains a Retry action
awaitingApproval.note: Actual SkillsSettingsPage after selecting a skill and failing its detail read. Upstream adds a Refresh-icon Retry below the surfaced error.

awaitingApproval.title: Sidebar hard failures and retained-session warnings
awaitingApproval.note: Actual Sidebar: an initial session-list error no longer claims no sessions; a failed refresh retains prior rows and discloses the stale read.

awaitingApproval.title: Session and workspace-group deletion confirmations
awaitingApproval.note: Actual Sidebar interaction: tiny inline confirmations become cancel-first modals. Group deletion names the workspace, session count and permanent-file warning.

awaitingApproval.title: Queue disconnected status with retained rows
awaitingApproval.note: Actual QueuePanel: disconnected state adds a visible banner; row mutation actions lock instead of permitting silent failure.

awaitingApproval.title: PR Center title and probe/list/detail recovery
awaitingApproval.note: Actual PR Center and detail components. Three distinct failure states are shown separately because one production instance cannot truthfully display all three at once.

awaitingApproval.title: Benchmark stderr remains visible on successful no-row output
awaitingApproval.note: Actual BenchmarkDialog supplied a successful fixture result with no measured rows and stderr diagnostics. No real benchmark/provider requests were run.

awaitingApproval.title: GUI schema visibility removes terminal-only controls
awaitingApproval.note: Source-backed illustration of setting availability, not a screenshot of the generated schema UI. Sample state: plan.enabled=true, plan.autosave=false. Upstream hides plan.autosaveDir unless both are true and removes the four named terminal-only paths from GUI settings. Existing fork palettes/layouts remain unchanged.

scope: Shown captures and labeled source-backed illustrations. A materially different merged visual requires another preview.
